THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS AN Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner of Labour which accompaniesthis order exists between –
Mr. M. K. Marcus Abepala, Hapuwalana, Marandagahamula
AND
Sri Lanka Transport Board, No. 200, Kirula Road, Colombo 05.

NOW THEREFORE I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powers vested in me by Section4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 Revised Edition), as amended by Acts, Nos.14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint Mr. S.Virithamulla, No. 128, Pirivena Road, Boralesgamuwa to be the arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlement by arbitration.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
Colombo.14th March, 2019.My No.: IR/COM/05/2017/05.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mr. M. K. Marcus Abepala, Hapuwalana, Marandagahamula
AND
Sri Lanka Transport Board, No. 200, Kirula Road, Colombo 05.
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is –

“Whether Mr. M.K. Abepala who had been interdicted without pay from 01.10.2013 regarding an incident which had taken place on13.07.2008, was served with charge sheet dated 16.10.2013 and charged a fine of 5 days salary and adviced, following the disciplinaryinquiry, had been caused injustice by the punishments given by the Sri Lanka Transport Board and the interdiction from Service without payfrom 01.10.2013 to 01.03.2014 and if so, to what relief he is entitled.
A. WIMALAWEERA,Commissioner General of Labour.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner General of Labour,Colombo this 06th day of March, 2019.
